item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Disparages Allies for Rebuffing His Requests for Military Assistance
item.summary: “We don’t need anybody,” the president declared, even as he said several countries had agreed to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Israeli military escalated ground attacks against Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon.

item.title: In Iraq, the U.S. Tried to Bring Allies on Board. Not in Iran.
item.summary: This time, President Trump went to war without preparing the public, seeking U.N. approval or even consulting allies. But they will have to pick up the pieces.

item.title: As Rockets Fly Overhead, Residents of Israel’s Border City Stay Underground
item.summary: The Israeli government evacuated Kiryat Shmona during the last round of fighting with Hezbollah in 2023. Residents who were told it was safe to return are again under fire.

item.title: As Israel Expands Ground Assault in Lebanon, One Strategic Town Resists
item.summary: The town of Khiam’s location on high ground just a few miles north of the border between Israel and Lebanon has made it coveted territory over multiple conflicts.

item.title: With Iran War, Trump Risks Stepping on Gains From His Own Tax Cuts
item.summary: President Trump’s war in Iran has raised some costs just as many Americans are starting to see savings from last year’s tax cuts.

item.title: Israel Denies That It Is Running Out of Missile Interceptors
item.summary: Israeli military says it had prepared for a prolonged conflict after a news report said its supplies of ballistic missile interceptors were running “critically low.”

item.title: Pakistani-Afghan War Takes Heavy Toll on Civilians
item.summary: Pakistani airstrikes have killed at least 75 civilians and displaced 115,000 in Afghanistan, with both sides vowing escalation and no talks in sight.

item.title: Nordic Leaders Praise Carney as They Discuss Arctic Security
item.summary: Canada’s prime minister got a warm welcome from leaders still smarting about President Trump’s remarks two months ago about taking over Greenland.

item.title: 4 Palestinians Killed When Israeli Forces Open Fire on West Bank Family
item.summary: Six members of a Palestinian family went out for a ride in the car. Only two made it back home.

item.title: Europe Rejects Trump’s Demands for Warships to Reopen the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: While some European countries said they were discussing ways to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz, several rejected President Trump’s calls to send warships.
